events:
on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry_run:
        description: "Build, test, sign, and package without publishing"
        type: boolean
        default: true
permissions:
permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write
  attestations: write
action_inputs:
with:
  name: sbom
  path: wispkey.cyclonedx.json
  if-no-files-found: error

with:
  name: wispkey-${{ matrix.target }}
  path: dist/wispkey-${{ matrix.target }}.*
  if-no-files-found: error

with:
  pattern: wispkey-*
  path: dist
  merge-multiple: true

with:
  name: release-metadata
  path: |
    dist/SHA256SUMS.txt
    dist/SHA256SUMS.txt.sigstore.json
    dist/wispkey.rb
    dist/wispkey.cyclonedx.json
  if-no-files-found: error

with:
  pattern: wispkey-*
  path: dist
  merge-multiple: true

events:
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, development, release]
  push:
    branches: [main, development, release]

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/owner_ipc/**'
      - 'src/core/**'
      - 'tests/owner_ipc.rs'
      - 'tests/owner_ipc_diagnostics.rs'
      - 'tests/common/**'
      - 'scripts/test-owner-ipc-contention.ps1'
      - '.github/workflows/owner-ipc-contention.yml'
  schedule:
    - cron: '37 8 * * 1'

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, development]
    paths:
      - 'src/operations/**'
      - 'tests/support/cross_node_fixture.py'
      - '.github/workflows/cross-node-acceptance.yml'

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 4 * * 5'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry_run:
        description: 'Compare branches without creating pull requests'
        required: true
        default: true
        type: boolean

on:
  push:
    branches: [development, main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [development, main, release]

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 7 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/dependency-audit.yml'
      - 'scripts/audit_dependencies.py'
      - 'scripts/tests/test_audit_dependencies.py'
action_inputs:
with:
  ref: ${{ matrix.branch }}
  path: audited
  persist-credentials: false

events:
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/compatible-test-artifacts.yml'
      - 'scripts/inspect_compatible_binaries.py'
      - 'scripts/tests/test_compatible_binaries.py'
      - 'tests/support/compatible_artifact_fixture.py'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/compatible-test-artifacts.yml'
      - 'scripts/inspect_compatible_binaries.py'
      - 'scripts/tests/test_compatible_binaries.py'
      - 'tests/support/compatible_artifact_fixture.py'
permissions:
permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write
  attestations: write
environment:
env:
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
  CHECKED_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
action_inputs:
with:
  name: unvalidated-bookworm-cli-helper
  path: dist/
  retention-days: 1
  if-no-files-found: error

with:
  name: verified-bookworm-cli-helper-${{ env.CHECKED_SHA }}
  path: dist/
  retention-days: 7
  if-no-files-found: error

events:
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/windows-receiver-test-artifact.yml'
      - 'scripts/windows_receiver_artifact.py'
      - 'scripts/tests/test_windows_receiver_artifact.py'
      - 'docs/windows-receiver-test-artifact.md'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/windows-receiver-test-artifact.yml'
      - 'scripts/windows_receiver_artifact.py'
      - 'scripts/tests/test_windows_receiver_artifact.py'
      - 'docs/windows-receiver-test-artifact.md'
permissions:
permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write
  attestations: write
action_inputs:
with:
  name: unvalidated-windows-receiver-${{ env.CHECKED_SHA }}
  path: dist/wispkey-windows-x64-receiver-test.zip
  retention-days: 1
  if-no-files-found: error

with:
  name: verified-windows-receiver-${{ env.CHECKED_SHA }}
  path: |
    dist/wispkey-windows-x64-receiver-test.zip
    dist/smoke-report.json
    dist/SHA256SUMS.txt
  retention-days: 7
  if-no-files-found: error
